title: Machine learning analysis of multispectral imaging and clinical risk factors to predict amputation wound healing.
summary: A prospective pilot of an ML model combining wound imaging and clinical factors to predict amputation healing, cross-validated, with AUC 0.89. The abstract identifies the model or learned operation and an observed evaluation; the conclusion is limited to the reported study setting. Original PMC full-text Methods and Results were checked; date 2021-07-24 reconciled to the primary record.
